name: Ugin's Mastery
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a colorless creature spell, manifest the top card of your library. (Put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever you attack with creatures with total power 6 or greater, you may turn a face-down creature you control face up.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you attack with creatures with total power 6 or greater, you may turn a face-down creature you control face up.

needs.what: an effect op that turns a chosen face-down permanent (selector, e.g. {controller: you, face_down: true, types: [Creature]}) face up without paying any cost, revealing its front face and firing turned_face_up; it must work for any face-down permanent, including a manifested noncreature card (701.40/708.8 effect-driven turn face up)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine has the turned_face_up trigger event, the face_down selector key and the manifest/manifest_dread ops, but no op that turns a permanent face up; transform flips double-faced cards, not face-down ones, and the only face-up route is the special action paying the morph/manifest cost. The trigger half is likely expressible as you_attack with a condition on attack_power_this_combat >= 6
